messages:
maria: quick design pass on streaming playground UI. biggest frictions: stop vs pause semantics unclear, token counter too prominent, prompt library peek pushes stream offscreen. figma: https://figma.com/file/playground-stream-mini
sam: Which 2 should we fix for beta?
maria: 1) clarify Stop vs Pause (copy + undo pattern). 2) lower token-counter visual weight by default.
alex: Dev: Stop = hard cancel, Pause = resumable. I can split actions but need copy + state transitions. Recommend undo toast ("Generation stopped — Undo", 5s) instead of modal on mobile. Also debounce token updates to 1s to avoid jank.
aria: A11y: set stream container aria-live="polite"; DO NOT make token counter a live region. Toast must be announced and receive focus; Stop needs an accessible name (e.g., "Stop generation (discard partial output)").
maria: Copy idea: short labels: "Stop" (tooltip: "Stops and discards current output"), "Pause" (tooltip: "Pause streaming; resume later"). Tooltips for discoverability.
sam: Default to inline low-density counter under prompt; add a user setting to enable floating token pill for power users. Track toggle adoption in metrics.
alex: I'll implement toggle + debounce + undo toast. Responsive: prompt library should be split-pane >=1024px, overlay on small screens so stream remains visible.
ops-bot: branch playground/stream-ux-experiment created. CI: green.
maria: I'll update Figma with toast states and copy variants, and write the a11y checklist. Assign: @alex impl, @aria a11y test plan, @sam metrics spec.
sam: I'll add events and dashboard slices. ETA next Wednesday.
aria: I'll run axe + NVDA tests once staged.
maria: Thanks team  small scope, big clarity wins. :sparkles:
